verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents outbound organization webhooks that notify your own systems when something happens in your organization, which directly covers subscribing to events. Its inbound webhook triggers (agents run when an external service POSTs to a unique URL) round out the event-driven picture, though those are the reverse direction. Missing for 10: details on supported event types, payload format, signing and retries, availability beyond the enterprise-features section, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
